@c(18)Treasure ranks@/c

When you open a treasure chest, you will obtain ranked equipment.
Once you return from the dungeon, you'll be given the chance to appraise,
keep, or sell the equipment you gained.

@c(18)Extending@/c

Once your score reaches a certain amount, you will gain one ##(COLOR_LP).
##(COLOR_LP)@c(19)s@/c are shown above and left of your face icon.
If you have an LP, you will recover when killed.

@c(18)Continuing@/c

If your HP drops to 0 and you have no ##(COLOR_LP)@c(19)s@/c remaining,
you will be prompted to Continue. Press @#(0) to offer
gold to Althena in exchange for resurrection.

@c(18)Continuing, for allies@/c

the Continue prompt will appear. Click on their portrait
before time expires to donate gold and revive them.

@c(18)##(START_MENU)@/c

In the ##(COLOR_START_MENU), you can change the ##(COLOR_ITEM_EQUIP)
to use on your adventure, or check the ##(COLOR_ITEMBOX),
which holds all the items you obtained.

The ##(COLOR_TOWN_MENU) allows you to select a
town facility and quickly move about.

In the ##(COLOR_NET_MENU), you can choose to either join a
random game already in progress or a Friend's game.

@c(18)##(LEARN_ABILITY)@/c

When you learn a ##(ABILITY), the player's
skills will be strengthened.
You can earn ##(ABILITY) points by leveling
up or through completing ##(COLOR_C_QUEST)@c(13)s@/c.

@c(18)About ##(ABILITY) Reset@/c

If you have learned ##(ABILITY)s, you can consume @#(36)##(SKILL_RESETITEM)
to forget the ##(ABILITY)s you learned and get the ##(ABILITY) points
you spent to reallocate them.

@c(18)About ##(ABILITY) Items@/c

You can put ##(ABILITY) items in your bag and use them.
You can now buy rune stones.

@c(18)Item usage and replenishment@/c

Each item can be used a certain number of times during an adventure.
When you return to town, your equipped items will be restocked,
as long as they have restocks remaining.

Art you obtain from quests can be viewed at any time
by selecting the ##(COLOR_GALLERY) option in the Guild.
